evidence.citation: Artifact steps 1–6 require re-running the three cases with fresh context-free agents, separately judging outputs, inspecting the checkout after every run, recording evidence, iterating only on defensible edits until improvement is demonstrated, and reporting before/after results.
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required work validates the revised completion criterion and protects isolation, provenance, integrity, and reproducibility. The repeated sweep is tied to demonstrating improvement, so it is not materially unnecessary under C1.
